##### Project general facts

Smart Heights by DAMAC is a distinguished commercial development designed to combine functionality, flexibility, and a premium business environment within one sophisticated destination. The project offers a selection of fitted and shell-and-core office spaces, complemented by retail units on the ground floor, providing an attractive mix of commercial opportunities for both businesses and investors.

The project offers an impressive range of amenities designed to create a comfortable and convenient environment for tenants throughout the day. These include a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, spa, elegant reception and lobby areas, 24-hour security, high-speed elevators, and extensive multi-level parking, creating a well-rounded and professional setting.

Smart Heights is distinguished by its polished contemporary design, quality finishes, and thoughtfully planned interiors that create a professional yet welcoming atmosphere. The combination of modern materials, well-maintained common areas, practical office layouts, and high-quality building finishes gives the project a refined character and makes it an appealing choice for companies seeking a prestigious and highly functional commercial space.

##### Location description and benefits

Barsha Heights is a vibrant and well-connected community in Dubai, offering residents a dynamic urban lifestyle with a comfortable mix of residential towers, cafés, restaurants, shops, and everyday services. Its central position near Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Internet City, and Media City makes it an excellent choice for those who value convenience and easy access to the city’s key destinations.

The area provides everything residents need close to home, from supermarkets, pharmacies, clinics, gyms, and salons to a wide variety of dining and leisure options. Green spaces, landscaped walkways, and nearby parks add a pleasant outdoor element, creating opportunities for walking, jogging, relaxation, and enjoying time with family and friends.

Excellent connectivity is one of Barsha Heights’ greatest advantages, with Dubai Internet City Metro Station nearby and direct access to major roads connecting residents to Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and other important districts. With its lively atmosphere, practical amenities, diverse community, and convenient location, Barsha Heights offers a highly enjoyable and well-balanced setting for modern city living.
